verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI app-builder, so the axis applies. The pack never documents running the core Bolt product on your own infrastructure. The GitHub items list in-browser features (running npm tools, Node servers, AI control of the environment) but say nothing about self-hosting, and the hosting docs describe only Bolt's own bolt.host hosting and custom domains. GitHub sync and backup is an adjacent feature for exporting user projects, not self-hosting the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
